description: This file defines an internal interface IStressTestGrain within the Orleans framework, specifying asynchronous methods for stress testing grains, such as messaging, lookup, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: IStressTestGrain
classes.description: An internal interface for stress testing grains in Orleans, defining asynchronous methods for various operations including messaging, lookup, and grain reference retrieval.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Retrieves a label associated with the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the grain.

methods.name: PingOthers
methods.description: Pings other grains identified by their IDs.

methods.name: LookUpMany
methods.description: Performs a lookup for multiple grains, returning detailed information including grain IDs, ETags, and silo addresses.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Returns the same byte array data back.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Pings the grain with provided data.

methods.name: PingWithDelay
methods.description: Pings the grain with data after a specified delay.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Obtains a reference to the grain itself.
